//: Port of this folder's denver.yml (+ the ../zephyr-devshell base it
imports) to devbox. Written to spec and NOT executed -- see
../PORTING-devbox.md.
denver original: five stages, split across two folders --
../zephyr-devshell/denver.yml   the shared base, 'runnable: false'
./denver.yml                    ONLY the 4.3.1 pins, via 'import:'
GAP (structural) -- LAYERING. devbox has no `import: ../sibling-env`.
Its composition mechanisms are plugins (`include`) and, for multi-project
repos, workspace-style layouts -- neither of which expresses 'inherit that
folder's whole environment and override three keys'. The base has
therefore been FLATTENED into this file, which loses exactly the property
the two-folder split exists to demonstrate: that five sibling repos share
one base and each add a handful of lines. There is no port of
../zephyr-devshell/ as a base, because devbox has no notion of a
non-runnable, inherit-only environment.
GAP (hard) -- WEST. Stages 4 and 5 run `west update` (clone ~40 pinned
repos), `west patches`, `west blobs`, and then install whatever python
packages the freshly-cloned modules turn out to declare
(`west packages pip`). That last set is not knowable until stage 4 has
run. devbox's init_hook is one hook, not an ordered pipeline with
fingerprinting, so the scripts below have to be invoked by hand and in the
right order.
GAP -- no equivalent of denver's `no-index: auto` offline install against
the conan-provided wheel cache (UV_FIND_LINKS), of `venv-patcher:`, of
`skip-if:`, or of `freeze-to:` writing requirements.final.txt back into
the tree.
